docs.cover_letter:
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Lisbon, Portugal

Hiring Manager
Tessel Cargo Software

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer position on the Routing & Tracking team. I bring seven years of production backend experience building and operating Java services, including REST APIs, relational database-backed applications, and event-driven workflows—experience that aligns with the role’s acceptance of Java as a comparable backend language.

In my current role at Tejo Insurance Tech, I develop and maintain seven Spring Boot microservices and designed an OpenAPI-versioned partner quoting API used by 12 broker partners. I also produce and consume Kafka events in the claims workflow, where introducing idempotent consumers and an outbox table eliminated duplicate claim records. By adding Redis caching and resolving JPA N+1 queries, I reduced quote endpoint p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds. These projects have given me practical experience with API design, event-stream reliability, and performance improvement in production.

I also bring automated-testing and delivery experience: I used Testcontainers to raise payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70%, and in my current role I deploy to AWS EKS with Helm and Jenkins pipelines. I take part in a monthly on-call rotation. Tessel’s focus on dependable live shipment tracking, event streams, and engineers taking ownership of the services they run makes this role a strong match for the work I have done across service development and production operations.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and event-driven systems experience could contribute to Tessel’s Routing & Tracking platform. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
